9.11.1. qnav.util.constants

9.11.1.1. constants.py

summary:

A list of calculation constants that are across the toolbox. This shared module contains a collection of geological constants that are repeatedly used by multiple functions within the toolbox

author:

Michael Wright - mjwright@liverpool.ac.uk

version:

1.0.0 - First implementation of this module.

qnav.util.constants.G = 9.81

\(g\) - The average gravitation acceleration.

qnav.util.constants.F = 0.0033528106647474805

\(f\) - Flattening measure of the WGS84 spheroid.

qnav.util.constants.POLAR_AXIS_A = 6378137.0

\(a\) - Semi-major axis equator radius (m).

qnav.util.constants.R_E = 6367444.65712259

\(R_e\) - The average radius of the Earth (m).

qnav.util.constants.ECC_SQ = 0.006694379990141316

\(e^2\) - The squared first eccentricity value for the Earth.

Type:

#

qnav.util.constants.ECC = 0.08181919084262149

\(e\) - The first eccentricity value for the Earth.

qnav.util.constants.ECC_PRIME = 0.08209443794969568

\(e'\) - The second eccentricity value for the Earth.

qnav.util.constants.G_E = 9.78032533590389

\({\gamma}_e\) - Normal gravity at Equator (m/s**2).

qnav.util.constants.G_P = 9.832184937863401

\({\gamma}_b\) - Normal gravity at Poles (m/s**2).

qnav.util.constants.OMEGA_E = 7.2921159e-05

\({\omega}_e\) - Approximate rotation rate of the Earth (m/s**2).

qnav.util.constants.GM = 398600441880000.0

\(GM\) - The Geocentric gravitational constant (m**3/s**2)

qnav.util.constants.M = 0.0034497873577006006

\(M\) - Somigliana constant, used for calculation normal gravity.
